text:
maria: Quick sync  we have a keystore/KMS rotation + stricter egress SG planned for Fri 01:00 UTC. This affects APAC-fips region where HSM endpoints are FIPS-only. Concern: GPU warm-pool joins in APAC may fail if they can't reach the HSM or audit collector. Need a low-risk rollout plan.

ajay: What's the list of targets for warm-pool joins in APAC-fips? HSM endpoint, regional KMS, audit S3, telemetry proxy? Any external vendor IPs?

maria: Exactly: hsm-fips.apac.redwood.internal, kms.apac.redwood.internal, s3://audit-apac, telemetry-proxy.apac.red. Also a monitoring webhook to ops-runner.red for lifecycle events. No external vendors expected.

leah: Cost/ops tradeoff: privatelink for audit + HSM avoids NAT egress but provisioning in APAC-fips needs approval and takes ~8 hours. If we fallback to NATGW we risk high egress and QPS limits.

oscar: Suggest hybrid approach: do a per-zone canary using private-peering for HSM only, and temporary SG allow for S3/telemetry that we revoke after warmup. That reduces privatelink scope and egress.

maria: I like that. Security: can we get approved CIDRs for HSM peering?

security: We will provide explicit CIDR ranges for the HSM cluster and telemetry proxies. We will not approve 0.0.0.0/0. Approvals contingent on auto-expire rules and audit annotations.

devops-bot: Infra note: PR #507 updates warmpool module to add egress rules and a taggable ephemeral rule. Terraform plan shows 3 resources to be created: aws_security_group_rule.warmpool_hsm_allow, aws_security_group_rule.warmpool_audit_allow, aws_route.private_link_apac.

ajay: Can we add a mandatory canary gating step in the pipeline? pipeline should create canary warmpool, wait 20m, run decrypt + object write tests, then proceed.

oscar: We'll add a script:
```
# canary test pseudo
spin_warmpool --count 3 --zone apac-1
wait_for_nodes 600
run_keystore_smoke --max-retries 3
s3_verify_put --bucket audit-apac --prefix canary/
```
If any step fails, pipeline reverts SG changes.

leah: Also enable temporary audit-sampling down to 5% in APAC during the window and create an audit log event noting the reduced sampling and justification for compliance.

maria: Security insisted on the log annotation. Make sure retention metadata includes who approved it.

sre-oncall: Monitoring/alerts: create 3 alerts: keystore_decrypt_rate <98% for 5m, s3_put_errors > 0 for 2m, natgw_bytes/s > 100MB for 10m. Alerts to #oncall and trigger rollback runbook. Add a manual abort button in PagerDuty.

security: we'll sign off on the hybrid plan (HSM privatelink canary + temporary S3/telemetry allow) for APAC-fips for a 3-hour window. Requirements: ephemeral rules must auto-delete, change ticket must include pre/post metric snapshots, and post-change attestation form must be completed.

maria: Plan summary: 1) Friday 01:00 UTC, start with APAC-fips canary (3 nodes) wired to HSM via privatelink peering and tightened SG. 2) Run the smoke script (decrypt + s3 put) for 20m. 3) If green, expand to additional zones with ephemeral S3/telemetry CIDRs and 5% audit sampling. 4) Monitor alerts for 60m after full rollout, auto-rollback on alert. 5) Auto-remove ephemeral SG rules after 3h or on rollback. 6) Complete attestation + post-mortem.

ajay: +1. I'll add the canary gating to CI and dashboards.

oscar: I'll prepare the privatelink terraform and estimate the time to promote to prod if canary passes.

maria: Everyone please review PR #507 and the runbook at https://runbooks.redwood.internal/keystore-fips-cutover before EOD. If no objections, we'll schedule the maintenance window. :white_check_mark:
